note: Every entry records its source (B2-R2). No published tonewood value is included because none could be consulted when this file was written (no network access to the USDA Forest Products Laboratory Wood Handbook, FPL-GTR-282); see 'omissions'. Add species only from a source that has been read, with the table or page and the derivation of every field.

materials.name: p0_5_reference_plate
materials.description: Spruce-like orthotropic plate material of the P0.5 reference solver (P0.5-T4). Not a measurement of any wood.

source.author: this repository (phase P0.5)
source.title: Reference solver: the plate for P0.5-T4
source.locator: docs/dev/reference-solver.md, paragraph after the test table

derivation.lossFactor: not part of the P0.5 plate (lossless reference); 0.01 is a placeholder of the B1 example instruments (instruments/examples), not a measurement
derivation.moistureSlopes: not available: all four slopes are taken as zero

omissions: Sitka spruce, Norway (European) spruce, Engelmann spruce, western red cedar, maple, mahogany, Indian rosewood, ebony: not included. The constants (E_L, E_R, G_LR, nu, rho at 12 % MC), the loss factors and the moisture slopes must come from a published source that the author has read (candidate: USDA FPL Wood Handbook FPL-GTR-282 (2021), Chapter 5 Table 5-1 and Chapter 4; a US government work, public domain). The source was not reachable from the build environment, and values must not be written from memory.
Moisture slopes dE_L/dMC, dE_R/dMC, dG_LR/dMC, drho/dMC: no source consulted for any species.
